title: If You Had the Chance to Be Immortal

cues.text: While cleaning out your eccentric uncle's attic,
cues.en: While cleaning out your eccentric uncle's attic,
cues.zh: 你有個性格古怪的叔叔。 你在清理他的閣樓時，

cues.text: you find a chest with a sparkling potion.
cues.en: you find a chest with a sparkling potion.
cues.zh: 發現了一個箱子， 裡面是閃亮的魔藥。

cues.text: The attached tag declares drinking this liquid will make you immortal.
cues.en: The attached tag declares drinking this liquid will make you immortal.
cues.zh: 魔藥上的標籤宣告， 喝下它就會讓你長生不死。

cues.text: Your body will be frozen at its current age,
cues.en: Your body will be frozen at its current age,
cues.zh: 你的身體會凍齡在現在的年齡，

cues.text: and you'll become immune to disease and serious injuries.
cues.en: and you'll become immune to disease and serious injuries.
cues.zh: 你也會對疾病和重傷免疫。

cues.text: These effects would be final and irreversible,
cues.en: These effects would be final and irreversible,
cues.zh: 這些效果將是不可改也不可逆的，

cues.text: guaranteeing your existence at least until the heat death of the universe.
cues.en: guaranteeing your existence at least until the heat death of the universe.
cues.zh: 保證你至少能一直活到 宇宙的熱寂為止。

cues.text: So, the instructions are clear—
cues.en: So, the instructions are clear—
cues.zh: 所以，使用說明很清楚——

cues.text: the only question is, do you drink the potion?
cues.en: the only question is, do you drink the potion?
cues.zh: 唯一的問題是，你要喝下魔藥嗎？

cues.text: Generally, people consider death to be bad—
cues.en: Generally, people consider death to be bad—
cues.zh: 一般來說，人都認為死亡是 不好的——事實上，是非常不好的，

cues.text: so bad, in fact, that our lives are filled with precautions against it.
cues.en: so bad, in fact, that our lives are filled with precautions against it.
cues.zh: 因此我們的生活中 也充滿了避免死亡的預防措施。

cues.text: We often avoid overtly dangerous activities,
cues.en: We often avoid overtly dangerous activities,
cues.zh: 我們通常會避免過度危險的活動，

cues.text: and we willingly accept inconveniences to further reduce our chances of dying.
cues.en: and we willingly accept inconveniences to further reduce our chances of dying.
cues.zh: 我們也願意為了減少死亡機率 而妥協接受一些不方便。

cues.text: But if you were immortal, you could live as dangerously as you like.
cues.en: But if you were immortal, you could live as dangerously as you like.
cues.zh: 但如果你能長生不死， 你想過多危險的生活都行。

cues.text: You could pursue any goal on as long a timeline as you need.
cues.en: You could pursue any goal on as long a timeline as you need.
cues.zh: 你也可以任意追夢， 要投入多少時間都行。

cues.text: You’d be free to enjoy a boundless horizon
cues.en: You’d be free to enjoy a boundless horizon
cues.zh: 你能自由自在盡情享受不受限制的

cues.text: of exploration, pleasure, fulfillment, and novelty,
cues.en: of exploration, pleasure, fulfillment, and novelty,
cues.zh: 探索、樂趣、成就，和新奇感，

cues.text: all without the fear of death hanging over you.
cues.en: all without the fear of death hanging over you.
cues.zh: 完全不用擔心死神找上門來。

cues.text: Despite this, British ethicist Bernard Williams
cues.en: Despite this, British ethicist Bernard Williams
cues.zh: 儘管如此，

cues.text: thinks there are plenty of reasons not to drink,
cues.en: thinks there are plenty of reasons not to drink,
cues.zh: 認為有很多不要喝下魔藥的理由，

cues.text: most notably because an immortal life would be unbearably boring.
cues.en: most notably because an immortal life would be unbearably boring.
cues.zh: 最主要的原因是因為 長生不死的生活會無聊到爆。

cues.text: Think of how your favorite things can become less enjoyable
cues.en: Think of how your favorite things can become less enjoyable
cues.zh: 想想看，你能不斷重複做 你最喜歡的事而永遠不會膩嗎？

cues.text: with frequent repetition.
cues.en: with frequent repetition.
cues.zh: 吃到第十六顆巧克力松露球時的 愉悅程度肯定不及第一顆，

cues.text: Your 16th chocolate truffle doesn't bring as much pleasure as the first,
cues.en: Your 16th chocolate truffle doesn't bring as much pleasure as the first,
cues.zh: 吃到第十六顆巧克力松露球時的 愉悅程度肯定不及第一顆，

cues.text: and you might grow sick of truffles altogether if you ate them every day.
cues.en: and you might grow sick of truffles altogether if you ate them every day.
cues.zh: 天天吃松露球可能也會吃到想吐。

cues.text: Following this logic,
cues.en: Following this logic,
cues.zh: 依照這個邏輯，

cues.text: Williams argues that repeating the same activities for all eternity
cues.en: Williams argues that repeating the same activities for all eternity
cues.zh: 威廉姆斯認為， 永無止境地重複做某活動

cues.text: would be horribly monotonous.
cues.en: would be horribly monotonous.
cues.zh: 會單調至極。

cues.text: On the other hand, philosopher John Martin Fischer
cues.en: On the other hand, philosopher John Martin Fischer
cues.zh: 另一方面，哲學家約翰‧馬丁‧費雪

cues.text: argues that while some pleasurable experiences do have diminishing returns,
cues.en: argues that while some pleasurable experiences do have diminishing returns,
cues.zh: 認為雖然有些讓人愉悅的體驗 確實會因為次數增加而效應遞減，

cues.text: others don’t.
cues.en: others don’t.
cues.zh: 但有些卻不會。

cues.text: Surely watching a beautiful sunset would remain fresh,
cues.en: Surely watching a beautiful sunset would remain fresh,
cues.zh: 當然，看美麗的日落 會一直保有新鮮感，

cues.text: even after thousands of years?
cues.en: even after thousands of years?
cues.zh: 即使看了幾千年？

cues.text: And since we already tend to forget things in our human lifespan,
cues.en: And since we already tend to forget things in our human lifespan,
cues.zh: 因為我們在人類壽命期間 就已經會忘記很多事了，

cues.text: it seems reasonable that after several centuries
cues.en: it seems reasonable that after several centuries
cues.zh: 可以合理推測，經過幾世紀之後，

cues.text: you could enjoy a previously exhausted experience.
cues.en: you could enjoy a previously exhausted experience.
cues.zh: 你就可以再次享受 先前已經厭倦的體驗。

cues.text: Besides, even if some pleasures fade,
cues.en: Besides, even if some pleasures fade,
cues.zh: 此外，即使某些樂趣會漸漸淡去，

cues.text: the pursuit of certain goals could last forever.
cues.en: the pursuit of certain goals could last forever.
cues.zh: 對某些夢想的追尋 也可以永遠持續下去。

cues.text: Fischer and Benjamin Mitchell-Yellin point out that even an immortal
cues.en: Fischer and Benjamin Mitchell-Yellin point out that even an immortal
cues.zh: 費雪和班傑明‧米契爾—耶林 指出即使長生不死的人

cues.text: couldn’t read every novel ever written while keeping up with new releases.
cues.en: couldn’t read every novel ever written while keeping up with new releases.
cues.zh: 也無法讀完世上所有的小說 同時還能跟上新出版的作品。

cues.text: And J.J. Wisnewski imagines an immortal musician
cues.en: And J.J. Wisnewski imagines an immortal musician
cues.zh: 而 J‧J‧威斯涅斯基則想像 一位長生不死的音樂家

cues.text: who learns all existing instruments and any new ones that are invented.
cues.en: who learns all existing instruments and any new ones that are invented.
cues.zh: 學會了所有既有的樂器，

cues.text: And those are just personal goals—
cues.en: And those are just personal goals—
cues.zh: 那些還只是個人夢想——

cues.text: an immortal dedicated to advancing various social causes
cues.en: an immortal dedicated to advancing various social causes
cues.zh: 投身於推動各種 社會議題的長生不死之人

cues.text: would likely find their hands busy
cues.en: would likely find their hands busy
cues.zh: 很可能會忙到不行，

cues.text: navigating a constantly shifting cultural landscape.
cues.en: navigating a constantly shifting cultural landscape.
cues.zh: 在不斷變化的文化環境中摸索方向。

cues.text: Alternatively, perhaps the novelty sustaining your immortal life
cues.en: Alternatively, perhaps the novelty sustaining your immortal life
cues.zh: 或者，也許你可以從內在找到 新鮮感來支援你長生不死的生活，

cues.text: could come from within,
cues.en: could come from within,
cues.zh: 因為你可以改變 你重視什麼、追求什麼。

cues.text: as you change what you value and pursue.
cues.en: as you change what you value and pursue.
cues.zh: 因為你可以改變 你重視什麼、追求什麼。

cues.text: After decades of painting,
cues.en: After decades of painting,
cues.zh: 繪畫數十年之後，

cues.text: you might decide to become an astronaut or a chef or a farmer,
cues.en: you might decide to become an astronaut or a chef or a farmer,
cues.zh: 你可能會決定去做 太空人、廚師，或農民，

cues.text: each transformation opening up new experiences.
cues.en: each transformation opening up new experiences.
cues.zh: 每次轉變都會開啟新的體驗。

cues.text: However, Williams questions if anyone would actually want to live
cues.en: However, Williams questions if anyone would actually want to live
cues.zh: 但，威廉斯懷疑，

cues.text: such an ever-changing lifestyle.
cues.en: such an ever-changing lifestyle.
cues.zh: 真的會有人想要這種 不斷改變的生活方式嗎？

cues.text: Sampling every experience life has to offer
cues.en: Sampling every experience life has to offer
cues.zh: 若想嚐遍人生所提供的一切體驗，

cues.text: would require living untethered to a core set of values or ambitions.
cues.en: would require living untethered to a core set of values or ambitions.
cues.zh: 就需要過著不受核心價值觀 或抱負束縛的生活。

cues.text: And not only would this be profoundly destabilizing to your sense of self,
cues.en: And not only would this be profoundly destabilizing to your sense of self,
cues.zh: 這不僅會深深動搖你的自我認同，

cues.text: over a long enough timeline
cues.en: over a long enough timeline
cues.zh: 經過夠長的時間，

cues.text: you’d probably come into conflict with your past selves.
cues.en: you’d probably come into conflict with your past selves.
cues.zh: 你可能會與過去的自己產生衝突。

cues.text: In such a situation, would you even care about your continued survival?
cues.en: In such a situation, would you even care about your continued survival?
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，你還會在乎 你是否繼續活下去嗎？

cues.text: Immortality skeptics often cite the painful prospect of outliving loved ones
cues.en: Immortality skeptics often cite the painful prospect of outliving loved ones
cues.zh: 永生懷疑論者常引用 比親人活得更久的痛苦前景

cues.text: as a reason to remain mortal.
cues.en: as a reason to remain mortal.
cues.zh: 作為不希望永生的理由。

cues.text: But what about knowing that the current version of yourself
cues.en: But what about knowing that the current version of yourself
cues.zh: 但如果你知道 可以透過轉變成完全不同的人，

cues.text: could effectively die by morphing into someone totally different?
cues.en: could effectively die by morphing into someone totally different?
cues.zh: 讓當前版本的你自己， 有效地死亡？

cues.text: Williams argues that living within the constraints
cues.en: Williams argues that living within the constraints
cues.zh: 威廉斯認為，活在我們 自身性格設下的限制內

cues.text: of our own individual character
cues.en: of our own individual character
cues.zh: 是讓人生有意義的必要條件之一。

cues.text: is part of what makes life meaningful.
cues.en: is part of what makes life meaningful.
cues.zh: 是讓人生有意義的必要條件之一。

cues.text: Thinking about what makes life meaningful is very relevant here.
cues.en: Thinking about what makes life meaningful is very relevant here.
cues.zh: 在此很重要的是要思考 如何讓生命有意義。

cues.text: After all, the ideal outcome of immortality
cues.en: After all, the ideal outcome of immortality
cues.zh: 畢竟，長生不死的理想結果

cues.text: is the ability to maximize life and the good things it contains.
cues.en: is the ability to maximize life and the good things it contains.
cues.zh: 就是要有能力將人生 及人生中的美好事物最大化。

cues.text: But philosopher Samuel Scheffler argues that temporal scarcity—
cues.en: But philosopher Samuel Scheffler argues that temporal scarcity—
cues.zh: 但哲學家山繆‧謝弗勒 認為時間的稀缺性——

cues.text: meaning the lack of time— is essential to our valuing anything.
cues.en: meaning the lack of time— is essential to our valuing anything.
cues.zh: 也就是時間不足—— 是讓我們珍惜任何事物的關鍵。

cues.text: It’s precisely the fact that our time on Earth is limited
cues.en: It’s precisely the fact that our time on Earth is limited
cues.zh: 正是因為我們在地球上的時間有限，

cues.text: that forces us to form our values,
cues.en: that forces us to form our values,
cues.zh: 我們才會被迫形成價值觀，

cues.text: and determine what things are worth doing with the time we have.
cues.en: and determine what things are worth doing with the time we have.
cues.zh: 並決定什麼事值得 用我們有限的時間去做。

cues.text: For Scheffler, immortality undermines the very possibility
cues.en: For Scheffler, immortality undermines the very possibility
cues.zh: 對於謝弗勒來說，長生不死反而 讓人失去了過著有意義人生的機會。

cues.text: of a meaningful life.
cues.en: of a meaningful life.
cues.zh: 基於這些理由，及許多其他原因，

cues.text: For these reasons, and many more,
cues.en: For these reasons, and many more,
cues.zh: 基於這些理由，及許多其他原因，

cues.text: some theorists consider eternal life more of a curse than a blessing.
cues.en: some theorists consider eternal life more of a curse than a blessing.
cues.zh: 有些理論家認為長生不死 比較像是詛咒，而非福賜。

cues.text: Then again, a couple of centuries of learning, loving, and chocolate truffles
cues.en: Then again, a couple of centuries of learning, loving, and chocolate truffles
cues.zh: 話說回來，幾個世紀的學習、

cues.text: doesn’t sound that bad, does it?
cues.en: doesn’t sound that bad, does it?
cues.zh: 所以，你會喝下你叔叔的魔藥嗎？

cues.text: So, will you drink your uncle’s potion?
cues.en: So, will you drink your uncle’s potion?
cues.zh: 所以，你會喝下你叔叔的魔藥嗎？
